opening.argument: The speaker ties node participation to a specific recurring-income pitch: obtaining more nodes is said to yield one STRONG every day as “this residual income is unbelievable.” The video then directs viewers to buy STRONG through Uniswap, while the node form requires a contribution of 10 STRONG and displays a monthly maintenance fee payable in ETH. Together, the daily-reward claim, purchase instruction, and required token contribution and recurring fee establish a paid mining or node-returns scheme. The evidence does not establish realized returns, and the request to contribute only what one can afford is not itself a financial condition; neither changes the paid structure presented.
